text.text_excerpt: What a hidden gem! I was working nearby for Mardi Gras and my coworker mentioned that there was pita inside of the Red Zone. I was like, wahhhh?! So we wander in and there is a line in the back. It was busy for Mardi Gras! The chicken shawarma pita I had was fantastic! It was long and rolled tight like a burrito. All the toppings on it were delicious! I will definitely be back here! The owner was also out and was super friendly and nice to us.

This has to be the most random meal spot that my boyfriend and I have found and fallen in love with. It's at the back of the Red Zone so you might ignore it at first. We come here ALL of the time for take out! I usually order a Chicken Shawarma Wrap and my boyfriend orders a Steak Shawarma Wrap. It's prepared right in front of you and usually doesn't take very long! They allow you to choose your ingredients and quantities, which I really appreciate! Their wraps used to be huge! So much quantity for the price and made this spot probably the best in the city for shawarma wraps. However, recently we've noticed the wraps have gotten a little smaller with less meat. As all businesses have been...

This spot is my go to on the go meal you can never go wrong and the quality is always perfect. I made a to go order and had zero complaints. Gita fries are amazing and I can't get over how crispy they are even after my drive home to eat my food! You won't be disappointed getting your next meal from here! Very friendly staff as well!
